newsitem.title: USA: Bayou Steel sees good Q4 on shipments,prices.
newsitem.headline: Bayou Steel sees good Q4 on shipments,prices.

text.p: Bayou Steel Corp said Monday it expects strong shipments and stable prices to lead to a good fiscal fourth quarter.

"Bayou Steel moves into the fourth quarter (begun July 1) with a record backlog and we look forward to a strong shipment quarter with stable prices," President and Chief Operating Officer Jerry Pitts said in a statement.

"The Tennessee operating performance should continue to progress as we move steadily toward profitability, and our Louisiana operation should continue to be a solid performer. As a result, we expect another good quarter as we concentrate our full attention on the ongoing strategic business issues, cost reduction, product mix optimization, and market penetration," Pitts said.
The company reported consolidated net income for the third quarter of $2.1 million, or $0.15 per share, compared to net income of $0.2 million, or $0.02 per share, for the same period of fiscal 1996.
Bayou attributed the improvement in earnings for the third quarter to higher selling prices and lower production costs.
